checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same woman at kitchen table throughout
must.why: All frames show the same woman in the same kitchen with no identity change.

must.item: Subtitles cover complete sentence without omissions or inventions
must.why: Subtitles are visible for 'Today I want to show you...' and 'ways to make your mornings less stressful.', but the 1 s frame shows no 'Hi everyone!' caption while she is speaking. The greeting looks to be missing.

must.item: Subtitle chunks appear in time with speech
must.why: Different chunks appear at 4.1 s and 7.1 s, and none are shown at 9.6 s. The full transcript is not shown all at once.

must.item: Subtitles readable, inside frame, not covering face
must.why: The text sits at chest level, inside the frame, clear of her face. The thin italic serif with a dark outline is only moderately legible over the busy background.

must.item: Original speech audible and framing preserved
must.why: The framing matches the source. Audio is present at a peak of -0.6 dB, but the speech cannot be verified.

exact_text.read_as: No caption visible at 1 s while she is smiling and speaking

exact_text.text: Today I want to show you
exact_text.read_as: Today I want to show you three easy
'three easy' ends one caption and 'ways' starts the next, so the phrase is split across two captions

exact_text.text: to make your mornings less stressful.
exact_text.read_as: ways to make your mornings less stressful.

faults.what: The greeting 'Hi everyone!' has no visible caption at the 1 s frame.
The phrase 'three easy ways' is split across two captions.
The thin italic serif font is only moderately legible over the busy background and sits over her torso and hands.

summary: The framing and the woman are preserved and the captions are timed and placed well, but the opening 'Hi everyone!' appears to have no caption and the font is only moderately legible.
